generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder Should have carried out erection of at least 01 No of 33kV or above voltage class Substation/Additional Transformer works on TTK or PTK basis in the last 10 years preceding the date of bid submission and shall be completed and commissioned prior to 01 year from the date of submission of the Bid OR Bidder should have carried out erection of not less than 02 Nos. of 33kV or above voltage class Transformer Additional Transformer Work on Labour Contract Basis in the last 10 years preceding the date of Bid submission and shall be competed and commissioned prior to 01 year from the date of submission of the Bid OR Bidder who has executed Additional Transformer works of private firms under the direct supervision of ESCOM /KPTCL officers are eligible to participate. Such Bidder should have carried out erection of not less than Two (02) Nos. of 33kV or above voltage class transformer Replacement Work / Additional Transformer on Total or Partial Turnkey Basis in the last 10 year preceding the date of bid submission and shall be completed and commissioned prior to 01 year from the date of submission of the Bid, mandating satisfactory completion as a prime contractor for atleast one similar work of value not less than 50% of the cost of the contract.
